name: clinical-rx
description: Your personal clinical companion — offline-first clinical learning app (Electron + web)

scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:web && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p "require("./package.json").version")" && git push origin main
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p "require("./package.json").version")" && git push origin main
scripts.release:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$(node -p "require("./package.json").version")" && git push origin main
